test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V, then how is N related to F?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64886493bb300a8ef31f1507b44ed538becdacd7a98b6e26f230006fddf89fb3.png] 

According to the given information,

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Number

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 &
 %
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
Of B

 
 
 

The given expression is :

'D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V' → D is daughter of N, N is daughter of H, H is husband of Y, Y is daughter of F, F is wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/100513ed2c82f4bc264ed60d18d66f0e32cccd2963837fc9c9be98f91da2dd2d.png] 

∴ Here, 'N' is F's daughter's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter's daughter".**
